ko: MY WHEELS ARE SPINNING. I AM NOT.
I HAVE BEEN DE-SKATED.
SORRY FOR FLIPPING OVER YOU. NOT SORRY FOR THE REST.
MY TAILBONE IS NOW TWO TAILBONES.
I LANDED ON MY BUN. BOTH BUNS.
MY BUNS ARE BRUISED AND MY HAIR BUN IS GONE.
COUPLES SKATE IS CANCELLED.
SOMEBODY CALL THE RINK MEDIC. HIS NAME IS TONY. HE IS HOT.
TONY THE RINK MEDIC HAS SEEN WORSE. ON ME.
THE DISCO BALL IS SPINNING. OR IS IT MY HEAD.
I DID A TRIPLE AXEL. INTO THE FLOOR.
MY LEOTARD RODE UP. ALL THE WAY UP.
I AM FLOSSING WITH MY LEOTARD AND NOT IN A FUN WAY.
THIS LEOTARD HAS A WEDGIE THAT WILL OUTLIVE ME.
MY KNEE PADS WERE DECORATIVE.
WHO PUT A FAMILY IN THE FAST LANE?
I WENT DOWN FASTER THAN MY EX.
MY EX WILL HEAR ABOUT THIS. HE WILL BE THRILLED.
THAT WAS MY GOOD SIDE. I DO NOT HAVE A BAD SIDE. NOW I DO.
MY PONYTAIL CAME OFF. IT WAS A CLIP-ON.
MY LASHES ARE ON THE FLOOR. THEY ARE CRAWLING AWAY.
I SKATED INTO A WALL AND THE WALL WAS YOU.
THE BRAKES ARE ON THE TOE. I AM ON MY FACE.
MY TOE STOP STOPPED. I DID NOT.
I SEE STARS. AND THE SNACK BAR.
THE SNACK BAR HOT DOGS WERE A MISTAKE.
TELL MY PARTNER I GOT LAPPED.
I SPLIT MY LEOTARD DOING THE SPLITS.
MY SPLITS WERE A LITTLE TOO SPLIT.
I CANNOT FEEL MY HIPS. THEY WERE MY BEST FEATURE.
THE RINK MUST GO ON. WITHOUT ME.
MY SKATES WERE RENTALS. I CANNOT AFFORD THIS.
THE RENTAL GUY WILL SPRAY MY SKATES WITH SHAME.
THESE SKATES HAVE SEEN BETTER FEET.
I HAD THE MOVES. YOU HAD THE FISTS.
I FLIPPED OVER YOU. YOU FLIPPED ME OFF. FAIR.
MY SEQUINS ARE ON THE GROUND. PICK THEM UP. THEY ARE EXPENSIVE.
SEQUINS IN PLACES SEQUINS SHOULD NOT BE.
I HAVE GLITTER IN MY BRAIN.
MY GLITTER IS LEAKING.
THE ROLLER DERBY REJECTED ME FOR THIS EXACT REASON.
MY ROLLER DERBY NAME WAS GOING TO BE BRUISE ALMIGHTY.
I GOT TOO MUCH AIR. I HAVE NO AIR NOW.
WRONG WAY. WRONG DAY. WRONG FAMILY.
WE SKATE COUNTERCLOCKWISE. I AM NOW LYING CLOCKWISE.
OW. MY {WRISTS|ANKLES|LOWER BACK|PRIDE}. I NEED A LOT OF ICE.
WHO KNEW THE FLOOR WAS THIS HARD. I KNEW. I FORGOT.
I SAW MY WHOLE LIFE. IT WAS MOSTLY THE RINK.
TELL THE DJ TO PLAY A SAD SLOW SONG.
THE DJ IS PLAYING MY SONG. IT IS A FUNERAL.
I WANTED TO GO OUT ON A HIGH NOTE. I WENT OUT ON MY BUTT.
MY BUTT HIT THE FLOOR SO HARD THE FLOOR APOLOGIZED.
I WILL BE SITTING ON A DONUT CUSHION FOR A MONTH.
SPANDEX CANNOT HOLD ALL THIS PAIN.
MY SPANDEX GAVE UP BEFORE I DID.
THERE GOES MY PERFECT ATTENDANCE AT THE RINK.
I WAS ON A HOT STREAK. NOW I AM A WET STREAK.
SORRY. SORRY. SORRY. OW.
I APOLOGIZE TO YOU AND TO MY KNEECAPS.
MY KNEECAPS WANT A DIVORCE.
BOTH MY ANKLES SAID GOODBYE AT THE SAME TIME.
I PEED A LITTLE. IT IS THE SPEED.
THE SPEED MADE ME PEE. THE FALL MADE ME PEE MORE.
WHEEE TURNED INTO WHOOPS.
MY WHEELS FELL OFF. LIKE MY MARRIAGE.
MY HUSBAND LEFT ME FOR A SKATEBOARDER.
I THREW MY BACK OUT DOING A BACKFLIP. I DESERVED IT.
I AM NOT FLEXIBLE ANYMORE. I AM FLAT.
LIMBO CONTEST? I AM ALREADY UNDER.
MY PARTNER WILL SKATE ALONE NOW. SHE IS TERRIBLE AT IT.
I AM BURNING ON THE INSIDE. IT IS THE SPANDEX.
THE RINK FLOOR SMELLS LIKE FEET AND REGRET.
IT IS ALL FUN AND GAMES UNTIL A FAMILY PUNCHES YOU.
MY HELMET WAS IN MY LOCKER. NEXT TO MY BRAIN.
I LEFT MY DIGNITY IN THE PHOTO BOOTH.
THE PHOTO BOOTH HAS SEEN THINGS. MOSTLY ME.
MY LIP GLOSS IS ON THE FLOOR. AND MY LIP.
I HAVE A CRAMP IN A MUSCLE I DID NOT KNOW I HAD.
BOTH OF MY CHEEKS ARE BRUISED. NOT THE FACE ONES.
THAT WAS A PENALTY. FIVE MINUTES IN THE PAIN BOX.
I AM SPINNING. STOP THE RINK. I WANT TO GET OFF.
I GOT DIZZY AND LOST MY LUNCH. IT WAS NACHOS.
I WILL ROLL HOME. LITERALLY. ON MY SIDE.
I AM OUT OF THE RACE. THERE WAS NO RACE.
THE ROLLERINA SUPREME WILL AVENGE MY BUTT.
THE HEAD ROLLERINA WILL FINE ME FOR FALLING.
I FELL WITH GRACE. MOSTLY ON MY FACE.
THE JUDGES GIVE THAT A TWO. THE FLOOR GIVES IT A TEN.
AT LEAST MY HAIR STILL LOOKS AMAZING.
MY HAIR DOES NOT LOOK AMAZING. LIE TO ME.
I SHOULD HAVE TAKEN UP BOWLING. THE PINS FIGHT BACK THERE TOO.
MY LEOTARD IS NOW A THONG. I DID NOT BUY A THONG.
I AM GOING TO FEEL THIS IN THE MORNING. AND IN MY THIRTIES.
I AM IN MY FORTIES. I FEEL IT ALREADY.
MY BACKFLIP DAYS ARE OVER. SO ARE MY FRONT FLIP DAYS.
I LOST A WHEEL. AND A TOOTH. AND A BET.
I HIT THE FLOOR SO HARD MY SKATES KEPT GOING WITHOUT ME.
MY SKATES ARE IN THE PARKING LOT. I AM IN THE PARKING LOT TOO. IN PIECES.
I HAVE A BRUISE SHAPED LIKE A WHOLE STATE.
I TRIED A SPIN MOVE. I AM STILL SPINNING. ON THE INSIDE.
spawn: LADIES SKATE! EVERYBODY ELSE, DUCK!
WATCH THE HAIR. WATCH THE WHEELS. WATCH THE KNEES.
WE ROLL IN PAIRS. WE HIT IN PAIRS.
BEHIND YOU! NO, THE OTHER BEHIND!
I WILL FLIP OVER YOU AND SAY SORRY. THEN I WILL KICK YOU.
SKATE, FLIP, KICK, SORRY. THAT IS THE ROUTINE.
THIS LEOTARD IS ONE SIZE TOO SMALL AND TWO SIZES TOO SHINY.
SPANDEX AND VIOLENCE. A CLASSIC.
THE RINK IS OPEN! THE RINK IS EVERYWHERE!
WHO ORDERED A HIGH-SPEED BUTT KICKING?
DO NOT MIND ME. I AM JUST A BLUR WITH ANGER.
I HAVE FOUR WHEELS AND NO BRAKES.
NO BRAKES! NO REGRETS! SOME REGRETS!
TURN UP THE DISCO. TURN DOWN YOUR HEALTH.
I DID NOT STRETCH. THIS WILL HURT US BOTH.
I TOOK THE NIGHT OFF FROM THE RINK TO DO THIS.
THE BARON BOUGHT US NEW SKATES. THEY ARE USED.
SMILE FOR THE JUDGES! THERE ARE NO JUDGES!
WE ARE SPONSORED BY A LOCAL ICE PACK COMPANY.
MY GLITTER IS ARMED.
I DO MY OWN STUNTS. AND MY OWN HOSPITAL VISITS.
WE TRAINED AT THE ROLLER RINK BEHIND THE LAUNDROMAT.
TIME TO LACE UP AND LASH OUT.
WE SPIN. YOU GET DIZZY. WE WIN.
MY PARTNER IS THE BRAINS. I AM THE KNEES.
THE SNACK BAR IS CLOSED. THE FIGHT IS OPEN.
FASTER! FASTER! WAIT. HOW DO WE STOP?
OUR THEME SONG IS ON CASSETTE.
WE ARE THE ROLLERINAS. WE WERE A BAND ONCE.
EIGHT WHEELS! FOUR KNEES! ZERO PATIENCE!
HOLD MY HAIR. I MIGHT BE SICK FROM THE SPINNING.
LOOK MA, NO BRAKES!
I CAN DO THE SPLITS. WATCH. AAAAH, NOT LIKE THAT.
WE FLIP FOR CASH. YOU ARE OUT OF CASH. WE FLIP ANYWAY.
DO NOT TOUCH THE LEOTARD. IT IS HOLDING EVERYTHING IN.
THE FAMILY THAT SKATES TOGETHER GETS FLATTENED TOGETHER.
WE HAVE BEEN DRINKING SLUSHIES. WE ARE VERY BLUE AND VERY FAST.
PUT ON SOMETHING SHINY. WE ARE GOING OUT.
WE BOUGHT THESE LEOTARDS IN BULK. THEY ARE ALL TOO SMALL.
WE SKATE BACKWARDS. WE HIT FORWARDS.
